exchange_rates.note: The same dated rate as the Dog Food batch, so the two categories stay consistent. Selling prices are rounded to the nearest 5 LKR.

sourcing.royalcanin: Both Royal Canin rows come from the manufacturer's own US product pages: name, bag sizes, price, SKU and pack image are all read from the page's JSON-LD.
sourcing.retailer: The other eight rows come from Grange Coop product pages, which were downloaded and carry the product name, bag size, price, currency, manufacturer number (mpn) and pack shot. The manufacturers' own sites either return 403 to direct downloads (purina.com, hillspet.com, bluebuffalo.com) or 404 for the guessed paths (iams.com, acana.com, orijenpetfoods.com), so the retailer page is recorded as the source of both the facts and the price.
sourcing.stock: Availability was not captured from the pages, so every quantity is a demo figure and stock_type is DEMO.
sourcing.ratings: No source with a meaningful review count was found, so rating and review_count stay NULL for all ten.

products.name: Royal Canin Indoor Adult Dry Cat Food
products.description: Royal Canin Indoor Adult dry cat food is formulated for indoor cats aged one to seven years. The manufacturer's own page lists this recipe in 3 lb, 7 lb and 15 lb bags and publishes the price, pack image and bag identifier used for this 7 lb listing.

products.notes: The same JSON-LD also lists 3 lb at USD 23.99 (1-030111430403) and 15 lb at USD 67.99 (1-030111628169), all InStock.
